topic_ko: 여러 장소에서 공부하면 더 잘 기억한다
_note: 유형별 묶음 구조. 같은 32번 지문이라도 유형마다 passage를 다르게 paraphrase 한다. order/insert/irrelevant/writing 은 구조상 예외.

passage: If you tend to study in the very same spot all the time, it may be worth breaking the habit.
Working in a range of different places creates variety, and that richer experience can strengthen what you are learning.
Many experiments show that learners who study in at least two locations are more likely to recall the material later.
In one early trial, two groups memorized a list of words under different conditions.
Some students stayed in a single room for both sessions, while others split their time between two rooms.
When asked to recall as many words as they could, the students who had moved around performed far better.
Variety builds rich associations, even when those links form quietly in the background of our minds.
choices: why it is best to memorize word lists in a single quiet room
why college students prefer a favorite study nook to a library
how the brain stores words separately from their meanings
how studying in varied places helps learners remember material better
why repeating a list aloud is the fastest way to learn it
theme.explanation_ko: 늘 같은 자리에서 공부하지 말고 여러 장소에서 공부하면 풍부한 연상이 생겨 학습 내용을 더 잘 기억한다는 내용. ④가 주제로 정답.
theme.distractor_ko: ①단일 방 암기, ②선호 장소 비교, ③단어와 의미의 분리 저장, ⑤소리 내어 반복은 본문 초점이 아니다.

passage: Do not chain yourself to one favorite study spot day after day.
Spreading your study across several places creates variety, and that rich experience reinforces what you learn.
Research repeatedly shows that learners who use two or more locations remember the material more reliably.
In a classic experiment, two groups learned the same list of words.
One group returned twice to a single room, while the other divided the same time between two rooms.
On the later recall test, the group that had moved around clearly outperformed the others.
So mix up where you study, because variety quietly builds the associations that help memory.
choices: 공부는 늘 같은 장소에서 해야 집중이 잘된다.
단어 암기는 소리 내어 반복하는 것이 가장 효과적이다.
실험 결과보다 자신의 학습 습관을 우선해야 한다.
공부할 장소를 여러 곳으로 바꾸어 가며 학습하라.
여러 사람과 함께 공부할수록 기억이 오래간다.
claim.explanation_ko: 여러 장소에서 공부하면 풍부한 연상이 생겨 더 잘 기억하므로 공부 장소를 바꾸어 가며 학습하라는 주장. ④가 정답.
claim.distractor_ko: ①은 본문과 정반대이고, ②③⑤는 본문이 다루지 않는 내용이다.

passage: Always studying in one fixed spot may not be the best plan.
Using different places creates variety, and that rich experience can reinforce what you are learning.
A great many experiments find that studying in at least two places makes recall more likely.
In one of the earliest trials, two groups memorized the same list of words.
Some students used a single room twice, while others split their time between two rooms.
When tested, those who had moved between rooms remembered noticeably more words.
The varied settings formed rich associations even outside conscious awareness.
choices: 단어를 외울 때는 의미를 함께 떠올려야 오래 기억된다.
공부 시간을 길게 가질수록 기억의 정확도가 높아진다.
조용한 환경일수록 학습 효율이 크게 향상된다.
여러 장소에서 공부하면 풍부한 연상이 생겨 더 잘 기억된다.
친숙한 장소에서 공부해야 마음이 안정되어 효과적이다.
gist.explanation_ko: 여러 장소에서 공부하면 풍부한 연상이 형성되어 학습 내용을 더 잘 기억한다는 것이 요지. ④가 정답.
gist.distractor_ko: ①의미 연상, ②공부 시간, ③조용한 환경, ⑤친숙한 장소는 요지가 아니다.

passage: There is a simple change that can sharpen your memory: stop studying in the very same place every time.
Varied locations create a rich experience that reinforces whatever you are trying to learn.
Numerous experiments show that using two or more study spots improves later recall.
In an early trial, two groups learned the same word list under different conditions.
One group repeated the same room twice, while the other split the time between two rooms.
On the recall test, the students who had moved around did far better.
Variety quietly weaves the associations that make remembering easier.
choices: Why a Favorite Nook Is the Key to Focus
Word Lists: The Hardest Thing to Memorize
How Long Should a Study Session Really Be?
Change Your Study Spot, Strengthen Your Memory
The Science of Studying with Friends
title.explanation_ko: 공부 장소를 바꾸면 기억이 강화된다는 핵심을 압축한 ④가 제목으로 정답.
title.distractor_ko: ①선호 장소, ②단어 암기 난이도, ③공부 시간, ⑤친구와 공부는 초점이 아니다.

passage: Studying in just one favorite corner may quietly limit how much you remember.
Different settings create variety, and that rich experience reinforces your learning.
Many experiments confirm that two or more study locations improve later recall.
In one trial, students memorized the same word list in different ways.
Some returned to one room twice, while others moved between two rooms.
Those who moved around recalled far more, even though the extra links had formed in the background.
Variety creates rich associations totally outside of what we are consciously thinking.
implication.underlined: totally outside of what we are consciously thinking
choices: students should think harder while they are memorizing a list
moving between rooms distracts the mind from the real task
memory works best when we focus on a single idea at a time
people rarely notice how tired they become while studying
the helpful associations form automatically without our deliberate effort
implication.explanation_ko: '우리가 의식적으로 생각하는 것의 완전히 바깥에서'는 도움이 되는 연상이 의도적 노력 없이 저절로 형성된다는 뜻이다. ⑤가 정답.
implication.distractor_ko: ①더 집중하라, ②방 이동의 방해, ③한 가지에 집중, ④피로 자각은 밑줄의 의미와 다르다.

passage: If you study in different places, that helps create variety, and that rich experience can reinforce what you are learning.
Numerous experiments have found that learners who study in at least two places are more likely to recall the material.
In one of the first such trials, two different groups studied a list of words.
Some students returned to the same room twice while their counterparts spent the same amount of time divide between two locations.
When asked to recall as many words as possible, those who had moved around did far better.
Variety creates rich association, even when those connections form in the background.
grammar.explanation_ko: ③ 'the same amount of time'을 뒤에서 수식하며 '나뉘어진'이라는 수동의 의미가 되어야 하므로 동사원형 'divide'가 아니라 과거분사 'divided'가 와야 한다. 'time divided between two locations'가 옳다. ③이 정답.
grammar.distractor_ko: ①관계대명사 what(reinforce의 목적어), ②주격 관계절 who study, ④비교급 did far better, ⑤복수 지시형용사 those connections는 모두 옳다.

passage: If you study in different places, that helps create variety, and that rich experience can undermine what you are learning.
Numerous experiments have found that learners who study in at least two places are more likely to recall the material.
In one of the first such trials, two different groups studied a list of words.
Some students returned to the same room twice while their counterparts split the same amount of time between two locations.
When asked to recall as many words as possible, those who had moved around did far better.
Variety creates rich association, even when those connections form in the background of our minds.
vocab.explanation_ko: ① 다양한 장소에서 얻는 풍부한 경험은 학습 내용을 '약화시키는(undermine)' 것이 아니라 '강화하는(reinforce)' 것이어야 문맥에 맞는다. reinforce로 고쳐야 한다. ①이 정답.
vocab.distractor_ko: ②recall(기억해 내다), ③counterparts(상대편), ④moved around(여기저기 옮겨 다녔다), ⑤form(형성되다)은 문맥에 적절하다.

passage: Do you always study in the same spot? Don't.
Studying in different places creates variety, and that rich experience can reinforce what you are learning.
Numerous experiments have found that learners who simply study in at least two different places are more likely to __________.
In one early trial, two groups studied the same list of words.
Some students used a single room twice, while others split the time between two rooms.
When tested, those who had moved around recalled far more words.
Variety builds rich associations, even when those links form in the background.
blank.explanation_ko: 여러 장소를 옮겨 다니며 공부한 학생들이 시험에서 더 많은 단어를 떠올렸다는 흐름이므로, 두 장소 이상에서 공부하면 '학습 내용을 기억해 낼(recall the material)' 가능성이 더 높다. ④가 정답.
blank.distractor_ko: ①졸음, ②동기 상실, ③단어 망각, ⑤혼자 공부 싫어함은 본문 흐름과 반대이거나 무관하다.

irrelevant.intro: If you always study in the very same spot, it may help to change that habit.
sentences: Studying in different places creates variety, and that rich experience can reinforce what you are learning.
In one early experiment, some students returned to the same room twice while others split their time between two locations.
When later asked to recall as many words as possible, those who had moved around did far better.
A tidy desk and good lighting are widely recommended for reducing eye strain during long study sessions.
Variety creates rich associations, even when those connections form quietly outside our conscious awareness.
irrelevant.explanation_ko: 글은 '여러 장소에서 공부하면 더 잘 기억한다'는 흐름인데 ④ '깔끔한 책상과 좋은 조명이 눈의 피로를 줄인다'는 무관한 내용이다.
irrelevant.distractor_ko: ①②③⑤는 모두 장소를 바꾸어 공부하면 연상이 풍부해져 기억이 좋아진다는 주제로 연결된다.

order.given: Do you always study in the same spot? Don't. Studying in different places creates variety, and that rich experience can reinforce what you are learning.

blocks.A: When the students were later asked to recall as many words as possible, those who had moved around did far better than the rest.
blocks.B: In fact, numerous experiments have found that learners who study in at least two different places are more likely to recall the material afterward.
blocks.C: In one of the first such trials, some students returned to the same room twice while their counterparts split the same time between two locations.

order.explanation_ko: 주어진 글의 주장 뒤에 (B)가 'In fact'로 실험 근거를 일반화, (C)가 'In one of the first such trials'로 구체적 실험을 제시, (A)가 그 결과를 보고한다. (B)-(C)-(A).
order.distractor_ko: (A)의 결과 보고는 실험 설정(C) 뒤라야 하고, (C)의 'such trials'는 (B)에서 언급한 실험을 받는다.

insert.insert_sentence: When asked to recall as many words on the list as possible, those who had moved around did far better.

passage_marked.text: Studying in different places creates variety, and that rich experience can reinforce what you are learning.
Numerous experiments have found that learners who study in at least two different places are more likely to recall the material.
In one of the first such trials, two different groups studied a list of words.
Some students returned to the same room twice while their counterparts split the time between two locations.
Variety creates rich association, even when those connections form quietly in the background.

insert.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장은 실험의 '결과'(이동한 학생들이 더 잘했다)이므로, 실험 설정을 설명하는 문장(④ 앞의 'Some students ~ two locations') 뒤이자 결론(⑤ Variety creates ~) 앞에 와야 한다. ④가 정답.
insert.distractor_ko: 주어진 결과 문장이 없으면 두 집단의 설정만 제시되고 어느 쪽이 더 나았는지가 빠진다.

passage: Always studying in one fixed spot may not be ideal.
Using different places creates variety, and that rich experience reinforces your learning.
Many experiments show that two or more study locations improve later recall.
In an early trial, one group used a single room twice while another split the time between two rooms.
On the recall test, the group that had moved around remembered far more words.
Variety builds rich associations even outside our conscious awareness.
summary.summary_template: Studying in __(A)__ places rather than one fixed spot creates rich associations that help learners __(B)__ the material more successfully.
summary.explanation_ko: 한 곳이 아니라 (A)varied(다양한) 장소에서 공부하면 풍부한 연상이 생겨 학습 내용을 더 잘 (B)remember(기억)한다. ④.
summary.distractor_ko: (A)는 varied, (B)는 remember여야 한다. forget/ignore 등은 본문과 반대이다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 여러 장소에서 공부하는 것은 다양성을 만들어 낸다.
writing.answer: Studying in different places creates variety.
writing.explanation_ko: 동명사 주어 Studying in different places + 동사 creates + 목적어 variety.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 여기저기 옮겨 다닌 학생들이 훨씬 더 잘했다.
writing.answer: Those who had moved around did far better.
writing.explanation_ko: 주어 Those who had moved around + 동사 did + 비교급 far better.

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 적어도 두 곳의 서로 다른 장소에서 공부하는 학습자들은 학습 내용을 기억해 낼 가능성이 더 높다.
conditions: be more likely to 구문을 사용할 것
writing.answer: Learners who study in at least two different places are more likely to recall the material.
writing.explanation_ko: Learners who study ~ 주격 관계절 + are more likely to recall the material.

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 흐름상 빈칸에 들어갈 한 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.
writing.context: Studying in several places builds rich ___________, even when those connections form quietly in the background.

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: Variety creates rich association, even when those connections form in the background, outside of what we are consciously thinking.
writing.answer: 다양성은 풍부한 연상을 만들어 내는데, 그 연결들이 우리가 의식적으로 생각하는 것의 바깥, 즉 배경에서 형성될 때조차도 그렇다.
writing.explanation_ko: rich association(풍부한 연상), in the background(배경에서), consciously(의식적으로).
